content.user_title: Create Better Google Stitch UI Prompts
content.value_statement: Google Stitch can produce generic designs when prompts lack detail. This skill provides structured prompt guidance for screens, flows, visual style, accessibility, and handoff.
actual_capabilities: Structures Stitch prompts with context, key features, visual style, and platform requirements.
Provides examples for landing pages, mobile apps, dashboards, e-commerce, forms, content platforms, and SaaS tools.
Guides refinement with annotations, variants, and focused follow-up prompts.
Covers responsive behavior, accessibility requirements, reusable components, and interface states.
Explains export and handoff workflows for HTML, CSS, Figma, and developer review.
limitations: Does not call Google Stitch or generate final designs directly.
Does not automatically validate visual quality, accessibility, or production code.
Requires product context, brand details, platform needs, and target users from the user.
Google Stitch behavior may change because the tool is experimental.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Product Interface
use_cases.description: Create a detailed Stitch prompt for a landing page, dashboard, or app flow before design review.

use_cases.title: Build Consistent UI Screens
use_cases.description: Define colors, typography, spacing, components, states, and responsive rules for consistent Stitch output.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Handoff
use_cases.description: Refine Stitch export goals with accessibility, semantic structure, asset notes, and developer-ready specifications.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Screen Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a Google Stitch prompt for a [screen type] for [target user]. Include sections, style, and platform.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Screen App Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Stitch prompt for a [product type] with onboarding, home, detail, and settings screens. Include navigation and states.

prompt_templates.title: Design System Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Stitch prompt defining tokens, components, responsive rules, accessibility targets, and interaction states for [brand].

prompt_templates.title: Production Handoff Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff-focused Stitch prompt with semantic structure, assets, breakpoints, states, and developer notes for [project].

output_examples.input: I need a mobile food delivery home screen.
output_examples.output: A structured Stitch prompt with search, categories, restaurant cards, bottom navigation, visual style, and mobile sizing requirements.

output_examples.input: Make my SaaS dashboard prompt more specific.
output_examples.output: A refined prompt naming metrics, chart types, navigation, empty states, loading states, responsive layout, and accessibility checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a design for handoff after Stitch export.
output_examples.output: A review outline covering semantic structure, component names, color tokens, assets, responsive breakpoints, and accessibility notes.

best_practices: Include user context, screen purpose, platform, layout, components, and visual style in every prompt.
Ask for loading, empty, error, selected, disabled, and success states before exporting.
Refine designs in small steps with annotations instead of replacing the full prompt.
anti_patterns: Avoid vague requests that omit audience, content, layout, and visual direction.
Do not omit responsive behavior when the design must support multiple device sizes.
Do not treat exported HTML or CSS as production-ready without accessibility and code review.

faq.question: Does this skill use Google Stitch directly?
faq.answer: No. It helps write better prompts for Google Stitch, but it does not call the Stitch service.

faq.question: Can it help with mobile and web UI?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompt patterns for mobile apps, responsive web pages, dashboards, forms, and SaaS interfaces.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for prompt drafting and review.

faq.question: Does it cover accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends prompt details for contrast, touch targets, keyboard navigation, labels, and screen reader support.

faq.question: Will it make production-ready code?
faq.answer: No. It can guide export cleanup, but developers should review generated HTML, CSS, and assets.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product goal, target users, screen list, brand style, platform, components, and required interaction states.
